# lucidity_scaling_policies (Data Source)

Lists every scaling policy in the caller's Lucidity account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lucidity_scaling_policies" "all" {}

output "policy_ids_by_name" {
  value = { for p in data.lucidity_scaling_policies.all.policies : p.name => p.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Lucidity tenant ID (e.g. lucidity_tenant.<name>.tenant_id) to act on, sent as the X-tenant header. Overrides the provider's tenant_id; leave unset to use it. Needed when authenticating as a service account with roles on several tenants.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) Every scaling policy in the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `attached_instance_count` (Number) How many instances the policy is attached to.
- `id` (String) Lucidity's numeric ID for the policy.
- `ideal_utilization_percent` (Number) Target disk utilization, percent.
- `max_buffer_in_gb` (Number) Maximum buffer, in GB.
- `max_disk_sku_size` (Number) Maximum disk SKU size.
- `max_fs_size_in_gb` (Number) Maximum file system size, in GB.
- `min_buffer_in_gb` (Number) Minimum buffer, in GB.
- `min_disk_sku_size` (Number) Minimum disk SKU size.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
